info.title: Lumbre API
info.description: Contract for the Lumbre system under test. Carts are scoped to an anonymous session or authenticated account; authentication and protected business mutations remain limited to development and test until production email delivery is configured.

200.description: Current account, or null for an anonymous request
A passwordless verification link was accepted for delivery

201.description: Membership registration accepted in a mutable environment

200.description: Ingredient detail when id is present, otherwise a filtered collection

post.description: Test-only hook. Development and production conceal it with 404.

ApiIndexResponse.description: API discovery document adapted to the active environment

NotFoundResponse.description: Resource or concealed test route was not found

ConflictResponse.description: The requested mutation conflicts with persisted state

AdministrativeProductCollectionResponse.description: Complete product catalog visible to administrators

AdministrativeProductUpdateResponse.description: Product updated at the requested revision

AdministrativeEventCollectionResponse.description: Complete event catalog visible to administrators

AdministrativeEventUpdateResponse.description: Event updated at the requested revision

ReadOnlyResponse.description: Mutation blocked by production read-only policy

AuthorizationRequiredResponse.description: The authenticated account lacks the required role

AuthenticationUnavailableResponse.description: Authentication is not configured for the active environment

MembershipPreferencesResponse.description: The authenticated account's cooking preferences and consent history

MembershipPreferenceMutationResponse.description: Created or updated account preferences with consent audit metadata

HypothesisMutationResponse.description: A new or deduplicated technical sheet

Set-Cookie.description: Issued only when a new anonymous session is created

OrderCollectionResponse.description: Order history owned by the authenticated account

HostedCheckoutResponse.description: Hosted Checkout Session or idempotent replay

ProviderEventResponse.description: Verified and deduplicated payment provider event acknowledgement

ProviderUnavailableResponse.description: Payment provider or webhook signing is not configured

ReservationCollectionResponse.description: Event reservations owned by the authenticated account

ReservationMutationResponse.description: A confirmed reservation and the updated event availability

FirePresetCollectionResponse.description: Fire-planner presets owned by the authenticated account

FirePresetSyncResponse.description: Server-authoritative result after importing browser-local presets
